summary.tldr: Requires the Justice Minister to table statements on how government bills may affect Indigenous rights, Charter rights, and UNDRIP.
what_it_does: Requires the Justice Minister to table, for every government bill, a statement on possible effects on Charter rights and on rights of Indigenous peoples under section 35 of the Constitution Act, 1982.
Requires the statement to say whether the bill is consistent with the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples.
Requires the statement to include a detailed summary of consultations with Indigenous peoples, or say that no consultations were held, when Indigenous rights may be affected.
Delays the bill’s coming into force until the first anniversary of royal assent.
summary.background: The Department of Justice Act already requires a statement on a bill’s potential effects on the rights and freedoms guaranteed by the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms. This bill adds Indigenous rights and UNDRIP to that statement.
